eyebrow.en: 成语 · 俗语 · 谚语 · 歇后语 crossword
eyebrow.s: 成语 · 俗语 · 谚语 · 歇后语 填字游戏

hero_h.en: A Chinese crossword that keeps the mind sharp

hero_p.en: Fill in idioms, sayings and proverbs on a grid of crossing phrases. Every answer comes with its meaning, read aloud, so each level teaches something new.
hero_p.s: 横竖交错的成语、俗语、谚语和歇后语，一格一格填出来。每答对一句，就弹出它的意思并朗读出来，每一关都学到新东西。

cta_note.en: Runs in any phone or tablet browser · No sign-up · No ads
cta_note.s: 手机、平板浏览器直接玩 · 免注册 · 无广告

f1_p.en: Every level is a fresh puzzle. New phrases come first, and the difficulty climbs slowly the further you go.
f1_p.s: 每一关都是新题。没学过的句子优先出现，越往后越难。

f2_p.en: Solve a phrase and its meaning pops up. Everything you solve is saved in 已学 to review any time.
f2_p.s: 答对一句就弹出释义，学过的句子都收进「已学」，随时复习。

f3_p.en: Each solved phrase and its meaning are spoken in Mandarin. Tap 再听一遍 to hear it again.
f3_p.s: 每答对一句，句子和意思都用普通话读出来，按「再听一遍」可以重听。

f4_p.en: Choose Simplified or Traditional characters on first play, and switch any time in settings.
f4_p.s: 第一次打开时选择简体或繁體，之后可在设置里随时更改。

f5_p.en: Spring, summer, autumn and winter landscape paintings change with every level, with soft guzheng music.
f5_p.s: 春夏秋冬四幅山水画随关卡轮换，配上轻柔的古筝音乐。

f6_p.en: Large characters, big buttons, no timers, three difficulty levels and limited hints to keep it challenging.
f6_p.s: 大字、大按钮、不限时，三种难度，提示有限，保持挑战。

promise.en: Free · No ads · No sign-up · Collects no data
promise.s: 免费 · 无广告 · 免注册 · 不收集任何资料

g_play.en: Tap a square, then a character

g_meaning.en: Every answer comes with its meaning

g_win.en: Review the whole level at the end
g_win.s: 过关回顾本关所有句子

g_book.en: All you have learned, in one place

h1_p.en: It turns gold, and the whole phrase through it lights up.
h1_p.s: 格子变成金黄色，经过它的整句会一起亮起。

h2_p.en: It drops into the square. Watch out for decoys in the tray.
h2_p.s: 字就填进格子里。小心字块里有干扰字。

h3_p.en: Right turns green and shows the meaning. Wrong turns red: tap it to take the character back.
h3_p.s: 填对变绿并弹出释义；填错变红，点一下就能把字拿回来。

seasons_p.en: Four landscape paintings, each with its scenery in the middle, behind the see-through squares.
seasons_p.s: 四幅山水画，景色在画面中间，透过半透明的格子就能看到。

a1.en: Yes. No ads, no purchases and no account.
a1.s: 真的。没有广告、没有付费项目，也不用注册。

q2.en: Do I need to install anything?

a2.en: No. It runs in the browser on any phone or tablet. Android users can also try the preview app (APK) from this page; it works offline. For an app-like icon in the browser, use “Add to Home Screen”.
a2.s: 不用。手机或平板的浏览器就能玩。安卓手机也可以在本页下载预览版 App（APK）试玩，不用上网也能玩。想在浏览器里像 App 一样打开，可以用「添加到主屏幕」。

a3.en: Yes, automatically, on the device and browser you play on.
a3.s: 会，自动保存在你玩的那台设备和浏览器里。

a4.en: Anyone who reads Chinese, and especially parents and grandparents who enjoy a daily puzzle to keep the mind active.
a4.s: 看得懂中文的人都适合，特别是喜欢每天动动脑的爸妈和长辈。

dl_note.en: Android 7.0 or newer · 8.5 MB · when asked, allow your browser to install apps
dl_note.s: Android 7.0 或以上 · 8.5 MB · 安装时如有提示，请允许浏览器安装应用

disclaimer.en: Preview build for early testing. It may still have bugs, and saved progress might not carry over to the official Google Play version, which will come once the app is stable. Installing apps from outside Google Play is at your own discretion.
disclaimer.s: 这是供早期试玩的预览版，可能还有一些问题。保存的进度未必能转到之后的 Google Play 正式版（应用稳定后推出）。从 Google Play 以外安装应用，请自行斟酌。

a5.en: An early Android build for direct download while the game is being polished. It is free like the web version. The official app will be released on Google Play when it is stable.
a5.s: 在游戏还在打磨期间，提供直接下载的早期安卓版本，和网页版一样免费。应用稳定后，正式版会在 Google Play 上架。
